scope: Verification of the requested Arizona hot-market architecture/design referral firms. Records are included only when the official company site publicly showed Arizona design/project evidence, a current relevant design leader, and a suitable email published on that company's official domain. Candelaria Design Associates, PHX Architecture, Drewett Works, and 3rd Story were excluded because they already received outreach.

records.project: Halo Vista and other Arizona projects in the firm's In the Works collection
records.projectEvidence: SWABACK's official current In the Works collection identifies Halo Vista, Museum Square Scottsdale, The Artisan Scottsdale, Clearwater Hills Residence, Mohave Estate, and Scottsdale Hillside Residence as work in progress.
records.personalizationSentence: SWABACK's In the Works collection—especially its Scottsdale infill and hillside-residence work—stood out as a strong example of projects where early site, drainage, utility, and permitting coordination can protect the design intent.
records.relationshipRationale: As managing partner of an integrated architecture, planning, landscape, and interiors practice, Sather is a relevant relationship owner for a complementary civil/site-engineering referral conversation.

records.projectEvidence: The firm's official Clearwater Hills page says Stratton Architects is a boutique Paradise Valley practice specializing in Southwest contemporary and hillside designs and expressly identifies founder/owner Stratton Andrews as a Clearwater Hills resident; its live projects presentation includes Arizona work such as Desert Mountain and Ocotillo Residence.
records.personalizationSentence: Your Clearwater Hills focus on contemporary hillside homes with indoor-outdoor living is exactly the kind of Arizona design work where parcel constraints, grading, drainage, and utility planning benefit from an early technical partner.
records.relationshipRationale: Andrews is the official site-identified founder and owner, making him the appropriate design-lead contact for a referral relationship centered on helping custom-home clients solve site and permitting issues without diluting architectural leadership.

records.projectEvidence: Fratantoni Design's official Current Projects page is live and identifies the Scottsdale office while stating it serves Scottsdale, Paradise Valley, and Phoenix; the official new-construction page describes the firm as designing new Arizona luxury residences.
records.personalizationSentence: Fratantoni's active Arizona luxury-residential work and integrated design-build approach suggest a practical opportunity to add specialist site, drainage, utility, and jurisdictional coordination when an estate needs technical depth beyond the core design-build team.
records.relationshipRationale: The official about page identifies Sam Fratantoni as the visionary leading the architecture practice; the published company-domain inbox is a suitable public route to open a relationship-focused referral discussion.

records.projectEvidence: Robinette's official On The Boards project page presents the Saguaro Ranch Home as work in development, and the firm also publicly lists a Saguaro Ranch Marana estate lot among its available Arizona projects.
records.personalizationSentence: The Saguaro Ranch Home on your On The Boards page stood out as Sonoran-desert work where sensitive site planning, drainage, utilities, and construction coordination can reinforce the home's relationship to its landscape.
records.relationshipRationale: Robinette founded the Tucson firm and is the named design leader on its official firm profile; his publicly displayed personal company-domain email provides a direct, appropriate route for a Southern Arizona referral relationship.
